item: Export, import and verify screens in Settings > Backup follow a language switch (row 366 a)
summary: Twelve renderers (export progress, paused and resume, cancel, inventory, import scan, run, verify, key rows, leftover copies) draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364) and leave the row 352 list. The import checklist moved into _uxImPaintChecklist, which the dialog's language listener redraws keeping every tick and field. The per-backup key rows carry English keys in placeholder, aria-label and title for the walker; a folder name is marked translate=no so it is never translated.
